description: 3 Bedroom/2 Bath - sleeps 6. Lower fl of house a 3 minute walk to Steps Beach or Marina. Great for couples or families - bring the kids! Rent the other floor, which is identical, if you want 12 to stay. Your biggest problem will be deciding whether to snorkel, body surf, or go whale watching or diving. Relax on the private patio. Enjoy fresh seafood at a waterfront restaurant or grill on the rooftop deck. We have everything you need for a great day in the sun - beach chairs, towels, and coolers.The spaceDOWNSTAIRS UNIT - sleeps 6(The entire house sleeps 12, 6 on each level. This listing is for the upstairs unit, you can also rent the upstairs unit. There are separate entrances, so it's ideal for small groups or extended family. Both units have access to the rooftop deck.) Stroll back from snorkeling at the Tres Palmas Marine Preserve, rinse the sand off your toes in our outdoor shower, and relax in the cool, ocean breezes while you barbecue on our beautiful, tiled rooftop deck. Enjoy morning coffee on the 1st floor patio. We provide a fully equipped kitchen and living area with A/C in all rooms, WiFi, and Smart TV. The master bedroom has a queen bed and an en suite bathroom. You can have each of the other 2 bedrooms made up with twin beds or with a king.Our location makes everything easy. Beaches abound, and we have everything you need for a great day in the sun - beach chairs, towels, and coolers. Rincon is the surf capitol of the Caribbean. We are 5 minutes from surfing beaches where you can rent a board and take a lesson. Or walk down the block and snorkel, float, or try a stand up paddle board on the marina's calm waters. If dry land activities are more your speed, our location gives you easy access to pickleball courts that have regular pickup games, running trails in the woods by Domes Beach, and horseback riding tours.Walk to the beach at the end of the block to enjoy a fabulous sunset. Or you can enter the Paseo Comunitario walking trail that goes past several beaches and ends at the clifftop Punta Higuera lighthouse park. The park has a lively atmosphere for the beautiful sunsets and you might spot a whale! The plaza in the center of town is 1 mile from the house and every Thursday night holds the Art Walk, a festival with music, food, and unique items handcrafted by local artisans. You'll also find the farmers market there every Sunday morning for tasty local produce.Your biggest problem will be to decide whether to snorkel, surf, or walk around the corner to the marina and take a whale watching or diving trip. You can have a pleasant evening in with our many books and games, listening to the song of the coquis, the native Puerto Rican tree frogs. Or walk over to one of the many waterfront restaurants to experience fresh seafood and other local delights. Bring a desire to relax and have fun - we supply everything else!Rincon is known as the “Town of Beautiful Sunsets”. It is a relaxing, tropical paradise on the west coast of Puerto Rico. Rincon’s unique location lets you enjoy the tranquil Caribbean, as well as the waves of the Atlantic. And our unique location lets you enjoy the best of Rincon. There is something for everyone - bars and restaurants, horseback riding, watersports galore, and easy access to local attractions like waterfalls and the famed Camuy Caverns.Rincon has it all, and Casa Tranquila puts it all at your fingertips. Come once and enjoy our hospitality and we bet you'll become one of our many repeat visitors who come back year after year.Guest accessThe entire house sleeps 12, 6 on each level; rent 1 or both. There are separate entrances, so it's ideal for small groups or extended family. You can have togetherness, and still have your own space. Whether you take both levels or 1, you will also be able to enjoy the rooftop terrace, the grill and all the beach equipment, and the outside shower at the end of the day.Other things to noteQuiet, residential neighborhood, a short walk from the beach and a number of restaurants. A large grocery store is 1 mile away and there's also various small bakeries and shops. A 5 minute drive will get you to the beaches on the Atlantic side and other bars and restaurants.

title: La Calma Suite | Coastal Boutique Escape
description: La Calma Suite is a spacious boutique studio steps from Rincon’s most secluded beach. Recently refreshed with upgraded bedding, enhanced Wi-Fi and renewed attention to guest comfort, this relaxing suite features a king memory foam bed with luxurious linens, oversized rainfall shower, AC, and peaceful atmosphere. Guests enjoy access to the pool, rooftop sunset deck with fire pits, outdoor BBQ and kitchen area, plus complimentary beach chairs, umbrella, cooler, and towels for relaxing beach days.The spaceTucked within one of Rincon’s oldest and quietest beachside neighborhoods, La Piña Boutique Hotel offers a peaceful boutique escape centered around relaxation, authenticity, and coastal living. With only seven suites and a maximum of 16 guests on property, the atmosphere remains calm, intimate, and uncrowded — a refreshing alternative to larger resorts.Located less than 100 feet from one of Rincon’s most secluded hidden beaches, guests can enjoy swimming, snorkeling, sunset walks, and quiet beach days just steps from their suite. A relaxed beachfront bar sits directly on the shoreline, offering sunset views, ocean breezes, live local conversation, and one of the area’s most authentic hidden gems.Despite the peaceful setting, the hotel remains centrally located to everything Rincon has to offer — including beaches, restaurants, coffee shops, nightlife, surf spots, and the historic town plaza. Guests can explore the famous Thursday night Art Walk in the Pueblo featuring local artisans, handmade goods, live music, outdoor dining, and dancing throughout the town square. Sunday mornings also bring Rincon’s beloved local farmers market filled with fresh produce, crafts, and island flavors.Guests also enjoy access to the hotel’s swimming pool, rooftop sunset deck with fire pits, outdoor BBQ patio, and complimentary beach essentials including chairs, umbrellas, towels, and coolers for effortless beach days.For those seeking adventure or relaxation, nearby rentals and experiences include snorkeling, bicycles, dive lessons, beach massages, and guided local excursions — all conveniently close to the hotel.Guest accessDuring your stay, you will have access to all the amenities at La Piña, including a swimming pool, outdoor patio with loungers and umbrellas, an outdoor kitchen and BBQ, private kitchenette, and our favorite feature, the rooftop sunset deck with fire pits. Or grab our complimentary beach chairs, towels, and umbrella, and head to the sand! (Blue and White striped towels are for pool and beach use. Please leave grey towels in your room) Your room includes a complete kitchenette with a microwave, refrigerator, coffee maker (FRESH local Puerto Rican coffee included), electric hot plate, and all necessary pots, pans, plates, and utensils. The laundry room is free to use, and laundry soap is included. In addition, all rooms come with shampoo, conditioner, body wash, and hand soap.Other things to noteBlue and white towels are for pool and beach use. Please leave grey towels in the room for showering and bathing. Please use the footwash by the front entrance or one of the two outdoor public showers to rinse off the sand before getting into the pool. There is a vacuum located in the laundry room for all to use just please return it after using it. All kitchens are equipped with cleaning supplies under the sink and a fire extinguisher. First aid kits are located under the bathroom sink and a large first aid kit is located in the laundry mounted on the wall by the door.
